summary: amazon.aws gained modules migrated from community.aws in Ansible 9: aws_region_info, aws_s3_bucket_info, iam_access_key, iam_access_key_info, iam_group, iam_managed_policy, iam_mfa_device_info and iam_password_policy.
questions: Which community.aws modules moved into amazon.aws?
Do I need community.aws for aws_region_info?

answer_card.title: Modules migrated into amazon.aws (1)
answer_card.answer_md:
These modules moved from **community.aws** to **amazon.aws**. Update FQCNs in your playbooks:

- `aws_region_info`, `aws_s3_bucket_info`
- `iam_access_key`, `iam_access_key_info`
- `iam_group`, `iam_managed_policy`, `iam_mfa_device_info`, `iam_password_policy`
